name: Generalizable Pixel-Wise 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A feed-forward method for real-time novel view synthesis of humans from sparse camera views. It selects two adjacent source views, predicts pixel-wise Gaussian parameter maps (position, color, rotation, scaling, opacity) for each view, unprojects them to 3D, aggregates them, and renders the target view using differentiable Gaussian splatting.
summary: Generalizable Pixel-Wise 3D Gaussian Splatting is a feed-forward method for real-time novel view synthesis that predicts Gaussian parameters on 2D image planes to eliminate per-subject optimization.
